contest: Most minions on Green spaces at round end.

story.line: Green copies spaces: a rival's, or your own again (rulebook). Whatever the best play was, you get it too.
story.greatGame: Round I you take Build Up for green and buy one cheap copier (Copyist or Stunt Double). Round II you sit right behind the strong players and Echo or Cover the best space they open, while Song Request copies a rival's action every round without a minion. Round III is the payoff: Echo or Reprise lands a second Initiation or Spree, and Greatest Hits fires every On Recruit you collected. Rivals answer by taking the best space last in a turn so nothing good is left to copy, or by buying Agents.
freshStart: Space I: "Copy the previous action. +1 green." (Echo, the heart; kept)
Space II: "Copy an action the player with the most followers has a minion on. +2 green." (copying the leader, on a space instead of Fan Club)
Space III: "Copy each of your other actions this round, one at a time. +1 green." (your own best turn again, on the center ring)
Member: "Round End: copy the Round End ability of a rival's member." (rides another cult's engine through members, not colors)
Member: "Game End: copy the Game End ability of a rival's member." (a reason for rivals to keep their scorer away from Green)
Member: "Whenever you copy an action, +2 followers." (one payoff card instead of four; Copyist as live)

cards.name: Build Up
cards.text: +3 green in round I, +4 in round II, +5 in round III.
cards.bestTurn: Round I, first turn: +3 green, enough with 1 more to buy Copyist [2 green + 3 any] on turn two.
cards.topCase: Round III: +5 green. Gather (Red) gives +4 red and +3 followers if you recruit; Build Up is the plainest of the fuel spaces and never breaks anything.
cards.ideaWhy: Plain fuel; says nothing about copying.
cards.ties: Puts a minion on a Green space for the contest; feeds green-cost members only.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 31: "green can stay… just default to gather style for now". Nov 7: "I do like the green actions for the most part".
cards.why: Needed fuel, no moment; the other colors' fuel spaces now add followers on a recruit and this doesn't.
cards.short: Round III: +5 green, the plainest of the fuel spaces.

cards.name: Echo
cards.text: Copy the previous action. +1 green.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, 4 players: the player before you takes Initiation ("Recruit a member in the shop costing 10 or less, for free. +1 red."). You take Echo: a free member costing up to 10, +1 red, +1 green, from an outer-ring space.
cards.topCase: Round III, sitting after the strong players: copies Initiation (a 10-cost member) or Spree (2 extra recruits, +6 blue), about 10 against the best round III space's 10. Even, not broken, because it needs someone ahead of you to take the big space.
cards.ideaWhy: One sentence, pure copying, reads at a glance.
cards.ties: Makes turn order and the Goes Last token matter for everyone: whoever takes a big space hands it to the next seat.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 7: "I do like the green actions for the most part" (no card named).
cards.why: The color in one card: the moment someone takes the best space and the next player says "me too".
cards.short: Round III: copy Initiation after the player before you, a 10-cost member free.
cards.risk: Overlaps Understudy: the same copy as a member.

cards.name: Reprise
cards.text: Copy an action with your minion. +1 green.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: you took Initiation earlier this round; Reprise does it again: a second free member costing up to 10, +1 red, +1 green.
cards.topCase: Round III, built around it: about 10 (a second Initiation), level with the best round III space; with Wallflower doubling a resource space it can reach 12 to 18. Strong, not broken alone. Useless on your first turn of round I.
cards.ideaWhy: "Do your own space again", one sentence.
cards.ties: Rivals can't stop it except by Agents moving onto you; it doesn't touch anyone else's pieces.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 27: moved to round I ("why not"; Claude flagged it does nothing on your first turn).
cards.why: Solid round III payoff, but it is Stunt Double's job on a space and has no sting for rivals.
cards.short: Round III: do your own Initiation again, a second 10-cost member free.
cards.risk: Overlaps Stunt Double: your own space again.

cards.name: Sample
cards.text: Copy the On Recruit of a rival's member. +1 green.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: a rival owns Con Men ("On Recruit: steal 5 resources."). You take Sample and steal 5 resources from someone, +1 green.
cards.topCase: Round III with strong rival On Recruits out: about 5 to 6 (one steal or one free effect), below Initiation's 10. Flat when rivals hold no good On Recruit.
cards.ideaWhy: Copy a rival's member; clear, but it rides what rivals happened to buy.
cards.ties: Gets better the more On Recruit members rivals buy; overlaps Red's Tryout ("Use the On Recruit effect of a shop member; it stays in the shop. +2 red."), which does the same from the shop and pays more.
cards.why: A real moment with the right rival card out, but Tryout does the same job better on another color.
cards.short: Round II: copy a rival's Con Men and steal 5 resources.
cards.risk: Overlaps Red's Tryout: the same job in two colors.

cards.name: Cover
cards.text: Copy an action with no minion on it. +1 green.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: Initiation is still open. You take Cover, copy it (a free member costing up to 10) and Initiation stays open for the next player.
cards.topCase: Round III: about 10 if a big space is still empty, but you also leave it open for a rival, so your gain over them is near 0. In round II it copies only round I and II spaces, about 3 to 4.
cards.ideaWhy: Copying an empty space is just taking it without blocking it; the twist is hard to see on a table.
cards.ties: Gifts the next player the space you copied; nobody feels it as yours.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 29: "i guess just leave it as is for now" (after its weak balance read; his idea then: "copy an action with a rival's minion on it").
cards.why: The one Green space you'd miss least: its best turn hands the same space to a rival right after.
cards.short: Round III: copy empty Initiation for a free 10-cost member; it stays open.

cards.name: Greatest Hits
cards.text: Copy the On Recruit of each of your members, in any order. +1 green.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: you hold Con Men (steal 5), Stunt Double (copy the action you just took) and Impersonator. Greatest Hits steals 5, copies a space and fires the copied On Recruit again: about 15.
cards.topCase: Round III, built around 4 or 5 On Recruit members: a balance run played it at 21 against 10.5 for the next best round III space, about twice. At the edge of too strong; flat (2 or 3) for a cult with no On Recruits.
cards.ideaWhy: "Play your greatest hits": the name says the rule.
cards.ties: Makes every color's On Recruit members worth more to a Green player, so the shop matters more to them.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 1: confirmed as his text; "copying round 1 amounts is too confusing" (refused a smaller version).
cards.why: The color's big round III moment, but its top case is about twice the next best round III space.
cards.short: Round III: fire every member's On Recruit again, about 21 against 10.
cards.risk: About twice the best round III space; overlaps Encore.

cards.name: Song Request
cards.text: On Use, once per round: copy an action a rival has a minion on.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: a rival took Initiation. You use Song Request on your turn: a free member costing up to 10, without a minion.
cards.topCase: Rounds II and III, used every time: about 5 in round II and 10 in round III, so 15 for a 9-cost card, plus the space you still take. Strong; owners won 35% of trial games (even share 25%).
cards.ideaWhy: An extra copy of a rival's space each round; one sentence.
cards.ties: Every rival's big space pays the owner too; it doesn't place a minion, so it doesn't help the Green contest.
cards.why: A strong engine card with a clear moment, but it is Echo again with no minion and no turn-order skill.
cards.short: Round III: copy a rival's Initiation without a minion, a 10-cost member free.
cards.risk: Owners win 35% of games; overlaps Fan Club, Tribute Band.

cards.name: Impersonator
cards.text: On Recruit: choose a rival's member. Do its On Recruit, and Impersonator has its ability.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: a rival owns Con Men. You recruit Impersonator: steal 5 resources now, and it's a second Con Men for Greatest Hits later.
cards.topCase: Round III: copies the best member at the table, e.g. a Game End scorer worth 6+ plus its On Recruit. About one top member for 8; fine.
cards.ideaWhy: Become a rival's member; obvious once read.
cards.ties: Every color's best member becomes a Green target.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5: "Impersonator should impersontate the on recruit".
cards.why: Good moment, and the best of Green's three become-a-copy members.
cards.short: Round II: copy a rival's Con Men, steal 5, and keep its ability.
cards.risk: Overlaps Impostors and Doppelganger: three become-a-copy members.

cards.name: Understudy
cards.text: On Recruit: copy the action taken the previous turn.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: the player before you took Spree; you recruit Understudy and get 2 extra recruits and +6 blue.
cards.topCase: Round III: about 10, once. Repeatable through Greatest Hits or Encore.
cards.ideaWhy: Echo printed on a member; a near twin of Stunt Double beside it.
cards.ties: Same as Echo: turn order decides what it gets.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 28: returned at 4 by Cory; Oct 28 11:37pm: reworded to "the action taken the previous turn".
cards.why: Echo on a member, with Stunt Double right beside it doing nearly the same; you'd miss it least.
cards.short: Round III: the player before took Spree; you get 2 recruits, +6 blue.
cards.risk: Overlaps Echo: the same copy as a space.

cards.name: Ensemble
cards.text: Whenever you copy your own action, +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: Reprise then Stunt Double on your own Initiation: +2 followers on top.
cards.topCase: Whole game built around own copies: about 4 to 6 followers plus its 3. Fine; mostly a 3-member body for 7.
cards.ideaWhy: Simple trigger, but a smaller Copyist.
cards.ties: Touches nobody else.
cards.why: Copyist does the same thing bigger and cheaper; no moment of its own.
cards.short: Round III: copy your own Initiation twice, +2 followers on top.
cards.risk: Overlaps Copyist, Impressionist and Wallflower: copy payoffs.

cards.name: Impressionist
cards.text: Whenever you copy an action or a member, +2 of its color (grey: any color).
cards.bestTurn: Round II: Echo on a blue space and Song Request on a red one: +2 blue and +2 red on top.
cards.topCase: Game built around copies, about 8 copies: 16 resources for 6. Strong but steady; no single big turn.
cards.ideaWhy: Fine trigger, but the "its color, grey any" rule adds reading.
cards.ties: Pays in other colors' resources, so Green can buy their members.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 29: "I like it" (about an earlier text, then a cloak: "Whenever any player copies an action, +1 of its color.").
cards.why: He liked the old version; this one is one of four copy payoffs.
cards.short: Over a game, about 8 copies pay 16 resources for 6.
cards.risk: Overlaps Copyist, Wallflower and Ensemble: four copy payoffs.

cards.name: Wallflower
cards.text: Whenever you copy an action, double the resources it gives you.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: Echo on Toast (+9 silver) gives +18 silver; Song Request on Spree gives +12 blue.
cards.topCase: Round III, three copies of big resource spaces: about +25 extra resources in one round, against about 10 from the best round III space. Over twice; the cost of 12 is the brake.
cards.ideaWhy: Double what you copy; one rule.
cards.ties: Makes the biggest resource spaces of every color worth taking early so Green can't copy them.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 28: "yes. let's make it 10". Nov 3: "copying Polish didnt double with Wallflower" (fixed to match the text).
cards.why: A real power moment, but its round III top case runs past twice the best space.
cards.short: Round III: Echo on Toast doubles 9 silver to 18.
cards.risk: About +25 in one round, over twice the best space.

cards.name: Fan Club
cards.text: On Recruit: copy an action the player with the most followers has a minion on.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: the leader took Initiation; you recruit Fan Club and get a free member costing up to 10, plus 3 members' worth.
cards.topCase: Round III: about 10 plus its 3, once. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: Fans copy the leader; reads right.
cards.ties: Points at the leader, so it works as catch-up.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 3: "Fan club really makes no sense" (old text); current text is Claude's pick under his go-with-your-gut.
cards.why: Clear catch-up moment, but one more copy-an-action On Recruit beside Understudy and Stunt Double.
cards.short: Round III: the leader took Initiation; recruit this, get a 10-cost member free.
cards.risk: Overlaps Song Request and Tribute Band: copy a rival's spaces.

cards.name: Copyist
cards.text: Whenever you copy an action, +2 followers.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: Echo and Song Request in one turn: +4 followers.
cards.topCase: Whole game, about 8 copies: +16 followers for 5. Strong for its cost; not broken in one turn.
cards.ideaWhy: The plain payoff for the color's verb.
cards.ties: Touches nobody else.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5: "yeah swap roadie out for shortlist green".
cards.why: The cleanest copy payoff, but cheap for what it pays over a game.
cards.short: Round II: Echo and Song Request in one turn, +4 followers.
cards.risk: 16 followers a game for 5; overlaps Impressionist, Wallflower.

cards.name: Stunt Double
cards.text: On Recruit: copy the action you just took.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: you take Spree (two extra recruits, +6 blue) and recruit Stunt Double with one of them: two more recruits, +6 blue.
cards.topCase: Round III on Initiation: a second free member costing up to 10, about 10 for 7. Big once.
cards.ideaWhy: The double does your stunt again.
cards.ties: Every color's big space is a target.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 7: "I really like stunt double… I don't think we should change stunt double".
cards.why: Cory's own star; the same-turn combo lands every time.
cards.short: Round III after Initiation: a second free 10-cost member, for 7.
cards.risk: Overlaps Reprise: your own space again.

cards.name: Tribute Band
cards.text: On Use, once per game: choose a rival. Do every action they have a minion on this round.
cards.bestTurn: Round III, last turn: a rival has 5 minions out, on Initiation, Spree, Toast and two more. You do all five: about 30.
cards.topCase: Round III: about 30 in one turn against 10 from the best space. Breaks the game; owners won 68% of 300 Hard games.
cards.ideaWhy: Play the rival's whole set; clear.
cards.ties: Turns one rival's whole round into yours.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 6: "let's put it on our cut list".
cards.why: Its top case is three times the best round III space, and Cory put it on the cut list.
cards.short: Round III, last turn: do all five of a rival's spaces, about 30.
cards.risk: Breaks the game: 30 in one turn; owners win 68%.

cards.name: Doppelganger
cards.text: On Recruit: this member becomes a copy of another of your members.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: copy your Song Request and copy two rivals' actions every round.
cards.topCase: On Wallflower or Copyist, every copy pays twice. Strong, not broken alone.
cards.ideaWhy: Becomes a copy of your own member.
cards.ties: Touches nobody else.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 5: "keep" (a copied used Encore gets its own fresh use).
cards.why: A clear engine piece, but one of three become-a-copy members.
cards.short: Round II: copy your Song Request and copy two rivals' spaces every round.
cards.risk: Overlaps Impersonator and Impostors: three become-a-copy members.

cards.name: Impostors
cards.text: On Recruit: this member becomes a copy of a rival's member.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: become a rival's Game End scorer and score it at game end.
cards.topCase: About one rival member's ability plus a 2-member body for 8. Fine.
cards.ideaWhy: Near twin of Impersonator, which also fires the On Recruit.
cards.ties: Every color's best member becomes a target.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 7: on making it a copy of a shop member, "No, I don't like this at all… a duplicate of another thing"; stays as live.
cards.why: Impersonator does the same and more for the same price.
cards.short: Round III: become a rival's game-end scorer and score it yourself, 2 bodies.
cards.risk: Overlaps Impersonator and Doppelganger: three become-a-copy members.

cards.name: Agents
cards.text: Rivals can't copy your actions.
cards.bestTurn: Round III: you take Initiation and the Green player behind you can't Echo it.
cards.topCase: Blocks 1 to 3 copies a game, worth what they would have copied. A counter; no moment of its own.
cards.ideaWhy: One rule, a blocker.
cards.ties: Only matters when a rival copies; his favorite use (pushing it onto a rival through a swap) needs a swap card from another color.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 28: "i like agents moved around as a sabotage bocker".
cards.why: He liked it as a sabotage blocker, but that use needs another color's swap; alone it is a quiet shield.
cards.short: Round III: your Initiation, a free 10-cost member, can't be copied.

cards.name: Bait
cards.text: Whenever anyone copies one of your actions, they −1 follower and you +1 follower.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: a rival Echoes your Spree: they −1 follower, you +1.
cards.topCase: 2 or 3 copies a game: about +3 for you, −3 for them. Small.
cards.ideaWhy: A trap on your own spaces.
cards.ties: Only fires when a rival copies, which needs another Green player; a 2-follower swing at most per copy.
cards.coryNotes: Oct 29: "clearly neutral for the player who has it (+1 -1)".
cards.why: Small swing, and it waits on a rival doing Green's thing.
cards.short: Round II: a rival copies your Spree; they −1 follower, you +1.

cards.name: Encore
cards.text: On Use, once per game: your next On Recruit happens twice.
cards.bestTurn: Round II: use Encore, then recruit Con Men: steal 5 twice, 10 resources.
cards.topCase: Round III on Stunt Double after Initiation: two more free members costing up to 10, about 20 once. Strong, not broken.
cards.ideaWhy: His wording; one sentence.
cards.ties: Every color's On Recruit members get better in Green hands.
cards.coryNotes: Nov 4: "Yeah, go with mine" (his wording). Nov 6: "i suspect bots can't use this right, so leave as is".
cards.why: His own words and a real moment; overlaps Greatest Hits (both repeat On Recruits).
cards.short: Round III: Stunt Double twice after Initiation, two free 10-cost members.
cards.risk: Overlaps Greatest Hits: both repeat On Recruits.

overlaps: Echo ("Copy the previous action. +1 green.") and Understudy ("On Recruit: copy the action taken the previous turn."): the same copy, space and member.
Reprise ("Copy an action with your minion. +1 green.") and Stunt Double ("On Recruit: copy the action you just took."): your own space again.

Song Request ("On Use, once per round: copy an action a rival has a minion on."), Fan Club ("On Recruit: copy an action the player with the most followers has a minion on.") and Tribute Band ("On Use, once per game: choose a rival. Do every action they have a minion on this round."): copy a rival's spaces.

Impersonator ("On Recruit: choose a rival's member. Do its On Recruit, and Impersonator has its ability."), Impostors ("On Recruit: this member becomes a copy of a rival's member.") and Doppelganger ("On Recruit: this member becomes a copy of another of your members."): three become-a-copy members.

Copyist ("Whenever you copy an action, +2 followers."), Ensemble ("Whenever you copy your own action, +1 follower."), Impressionist ("Whenever you copy an action or a member, +2 of its color (grey: any color).") and Wallflower ("Whenever you copy an action, double the resources it gives you."): four payoffs for copying.
Greatest Hits ("Copy the On Recruit of each of your members, in any order. +1 green.") and Encore ("On Use, once per game: your next On Recruit happens twice."): both repeat On Recruits.
Sample ("Copy the On Recruit of a rival's member. +1 green.") and Red's Tryout ("Use the On Recruit effect of a shop member; it stays in the shop. +2 red."): the same job across two colors.
notes: Green has 21 cards doing about five jobs, with two or three cards on each; the members are mostly near twins, while the spaces are the strong part (as Cory said). Only Echo and Song Request give rivals a reason to change how they play (take the big space late, or deny the copy); almost nothing hands anything back to the player copied. The round III payoff is spread across Greatest Hits, Wallflower and Tribute Band, and two of those run past twice the best round III space. The contest counts minions on Green spaces, so the member copiers (Song Request, Tribute Band) don't help it.
storyShort: Green copies spaces, a rival's or your own: whatever the best play was.
